cases.fullName: builds strict stable explicit revisions without rewriting the logical record identity
cases.invariant: Formal MemoryRecordV1 preserves one logical identity across strict immutable explicit revisions.

cases.fullName: atomically migrates the exact ML1 episode bytes into schema 2 revision and ADD operation
cases.invariant: Schema 1 episode canonical bytes IDs and hashes survive the atomic schema 2 migration unchanged.

cases.fullName: exposes only the active superseding revision and makes retract idempotent
cases.invariant: ADD SUPERSEDE and RETRACT are append only and active readers expose only the current unretracted revision.

cases.fullName: keeps one retract operation available after automatic episode ingest reaches record capacity
cases.invariant: Record capacity stops new ingestion while the independent lifecycle reserve still admits retract.

cases.fullName: rejects secret-bearing explicit text before any canonical revision or operation is inserted
cases.invariant: Known secret patterns fail before the canonical record and operation transaction.

cases.fullName: injects the active revision as historical-only context and selects zero after retract
cases.invariant: Automatic recall refetches the active revision identity and cannot use a retracted explicit record.

cases.fullName: adds, supersedes, diagnoses, rebuilds and retracts one explicit record without admitting a secret
cases.invariant: The product CLI completes the lifecycle secret and deleted-derived rebuild demo while preserving the canonical logical hash.
